data.value:
Click to Reset Phase angle and Magnitude back to Center (0° & 0) (i.e. No software alternations to the combined sum of RX1 & RX2)

data.name: btnEnable.ToolTip
data.value:

Even though RX2 appears to be OFF, it is ON. Sync button is automatically enabled But Sync will only be RED if all parameters between RX1 and RX2 are equal (NOTE: Sync will not occur if SR is enabled)

You need 2 seperate antennas for RX1 & RX2.
(For Receiver Beam Steering, you would want the 2nd antenna to be identical to the 1st but spaced far apart.) (For Receiver Noise reduction, you want the 2nd antenna to be a good receiver of the noise your trying to cancel out)
When ENABLED, move the Red Target Cursor around to find a spot to cancel background noise or enhance the signal of interest. Or try finding the NULL in the signal, then hit the 180° button.

data.name: comboDisplayMode.ToolTip
data.value:
Display Mode Selection:
Panadater: Spectrum analyzer showing the entire Frequency spectrum (based on current radio Sample Rate, and zoom level)
PanaFall: Panadapter & Waterfall combo NOTE: Click and grab bar between spectrum and waterfall to adjust or hit F9-F10 keys to adjust the window
PanaFall8020: Spectrum and Waterfall (80-20) NOTE: Click and grab bar between spectrum and waterfall to adjust or hit F9-F10 keys to adjust the window
Waterfall: : Spectrum analyzer displayed as a history recording the entire Frequency spectrum (based on current radio Sample Rate, and zoom level). The further down the screen, the older the data.
PanaScope: Panadapter & Oscilloscope combo
Spectrum: Traditional "Specturm Analyzer" for your current Receiver/Transmitter passband (with 0hz on left side)
Scope: Tranditional Osciloscope for your your current Receiver/Transmitter passband (AM mode shows NEG Overmodulation warning when scope shows a flat line)
Phase: X and Y dimensions represent Filtered I and Q (left/Right) channels
Phase2: unfiltered version of Phase
Histogram: Spectrum with the 0hz in the center (with a Green peak background)
Continuum: Display BandPass peak dBm vs Time (with Ant pos) Log File contains Date & Time, beam heading, Panadater peak dBm, and S-Meter dBm Right Click to Toggle recording Log Flle ON/OFF (times turn Red) Then Right Click on TXWaterID callsign box to open database Folder to view files

data.name: radFMDeviation2kHz.ToolTip

Sets the FM Deviation to 2.5 kHz

data.name: comboCWTXProfile.ToolTip

Audio INPUT Stages: A/D = Stage0 Front End to Digital Mixer = Stage1 Mixer (after the A/D converter) MIC = Stage2 input dBm after MIXER and MIC sliders DEXP = Stage3 Downward Expander / Gate EQ = Stage4 input dBm after EQ sliders Lev = Stage5 input dBm afer leveler gain LevG = Stage5 Leveler Gain display only CPDR = Stage6 Compander DX = Stage6 DX Compressor Mod = Stage7 Modulation Mode FLTR = Stage 8 TX Filter ALC = Stage9 input dBm after DX, Cmpd, Mode, TX Filter ALCG = Stage9 ALC attack dBm, foldback amount I/Q = Stage10 I/Q correction Scale = Stage11 Audio Scaling D/A = Stage12 back to Analog (to the PA)

data.name: TXIDMenuItem.ToolTipText
data.value:
Box to the right must be Green before you can Transmit a Waterfall TEXT ID or Image.
To send Text: Type in Text that fits in the Box. To Send bitmap: Type name of file with . on the end (i.e. test. for test.bmp) Must be a small 24bit grayscale image. Right Click on Call Sign Box to open Folder to place Bitmap into.
Red: Move your mouse into and out of the Text box to start creating file Green: Done creating the file the waterfall, ready to Transmit (Hit TX WaterID button) Yellow: Need to move mouse in/out of text box.
MAKE SURE WAVE OPTIONS ARE SET TO POST AUDIO for both RX & TX
